label: C
name: Scenario C - congestion from competing traffic
description: The monitored 1 Mb/s flow (fid 1) runs as in the baseline. From t = 3.0 s to t = 6.0 s a competing 1.5 Mb/s CBR flow (fid 2) is added on the same path, so 2.5 Mb/s is offered to the 2 Mb/s core link n1-n2.
known_cause: Competing traffic (flow 2, 1.5 Mb/s) was deliberately injected between t = 3.0 s and t = 6.0 s. Offered load on link n1-n2 is 2.5 Mb/s against 2 Mb/s capacity.
